title: John Kirby's group and a fight with its guitarist
summary: John Kirby formed his group himself; Bunn recalls hitting its jealous guitarist with his guitar after wisecracks about his solos.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Do you remember some time around '38 or '39, in there, John Kirby formed up a group?
After he played with Frankie. Do you know if that was like -- was that a spinoff? Did that come out of the Frankie Newton group or did John Kirby form that up himself?
John Kirby formed that up himself.
Uh-huh. That was with Charlie Shavers?
Charlie Shavers. Boy. Kirby, -- oh, boy. Charlie Shavers --
But you remember John Kirby himself.
Yeah. And the guitar player and I got in a fight.
I forget his name, too, now. What the heck's his name? Yeah. Jealousies. (Jimmy McLin, ? - ed.)
What was there a fight over?
Like a contest or something like that?

Just personal stuff. He was jealous. Jealous of me. I'd go out there and take my solo and he'd come back and start some cracking, you know, wise cracking, and I wouldn't take it. So I hit him with that guitar. And that's what started it. (Interruption)
That's right. So you get to know just what to do when you get ready to use it for some big money.
Won't be no playing around, you know?
